title: A licensee may not dispense or distribute substandard drugs or devices to a recipient not licensed or legally authorized to receive them
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(12), a licensee may not dispense or distribute any expired, outdated, defective, contaminated, counterfeit, contraband, or otherwise substandard drug or device to any person or entity who is not licensed or legally authorized to receive such drug or device.
exam_relevance: Tests the kinds of product 247 CMR 9.01(12) names, the two acts it reaches, and its recipient condition.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The paragraph does not itself identify who is licensed or legally authorized to receive such drug or device.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
